content.title: 2025 Internal Affairs Summary
content.summary: In 2025, the Arvada Police Department received 65 complaints, including 45 from citizens and 17 internally, with only six external complaints substantiated and 16 internal complaints substantiated. Disciplinary actions included suspensions, removals from assignments, and reprimands. The department also introduced a new finding category, \"Divergent Conclusions,\" for complaints with conflicting outcomes.
content.body:
## Internal Affairs Investigations 2025

In 2025, there were a total of 65 complaints made against members of the Arvada Police Department: two administrative investigations, 45 citizen-generated complaints, and 17 internal complaints. 2025 had one administrative review, which are historically generated by officer involved shootings (OIS). Both administrative investigations involved employee conduct which occurred off duty.

Of the external complaints, only six were substantiated. Internally, 16 complaints were substantiated. Employees received discipline or corrective action in the forms of suspension, removal from assignment, written and verbal reprimands, and counseling.

## Complaints & Internal Affairs Investigations

| External Complaints | 2022 | 2023 | 2024 | 2025 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Citizen Complaint | 44 (see note 1) | 29 (see note 1) | 36 (see note 1) | 45 (see note 1) |
| Proper Action | 7 | 6 | 16 | 37 |
| Substantiated | 9 | 5 | 10 | 5 |
| Divergent Conclusions | N/A | N/A | N/A | 1 (see note 2) |
| Unsubstantiated | 16 | 10 | 4 | 0 |
| Unfounded | 10 | 6 | 20 | 2 |
| Exceptionally Cleared | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

| Internal Complaints | 2022 | 2023 | 2024 | 2025 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Directed Complaint | 8 | 14 | 12 | 17 |
| Proper Action | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Unfounded | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 |
| Substantiated | 8 | 14 | 12 | 16 |
| Unsubstantiated | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Referred to IA for Investigation | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 |
| Exceptionally Cleared | 0 | 0 | 1 | 0 |

The Arvada Police Department uses the following terminology regarding the findings of external and internal complaints: Unfounded, Unsubstantiated, Substantiated, Divergent Conclusions, Outcome not based on Complaint, and Complaint Exceptionally Cleared.

**Note 1**: In 2022, Internal Affairs began keeping track of missed court appearances separately and are not accounted for in these numbers. In 2025, three incidents were documented, three of which were substantiated.

**Note 2**: In 2025, Internal Affairs added the “Divergent Conclusions” finding for complaints with opposing disposition categories.

## Personnel Actions

| Type of Actions | 2022 | 2023 | 2024 | 2025 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Termination | 1 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Resigned in lieu of Termination | 2 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Removed from Assignment | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 |
| Demotion | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Suspension | 1 | 0 | 0 | 1 |
| Written Reprimand | 3 | 3 | 6 | 2 |
| Verbal Reprimand | 6 | 3 | 2 | 6 |
| Counseling | 17 | 11 | 15 | 12 |
| Training | 1 | 1 | 1 | 0 |
| Exceptionally Cleared | 1 | 2 | 1 | 0 |
